page.overview:
Who is Tsugihagi?

Tsugihagi possesses a corpse with short green hair and has grey sclera and yellow eyes. She has normal pale skin albeit with a grey hue in shading with stitches covering her face, thighs and upper arm. She wears a long black skirt, a loose yellow cardigan with 4 buttons, and black clogs.

Nothing is currently known about Tsuguhagi's personality as she didn't speak a word in all her appearances. However, she is extremely loyal to Quanxi and her women.

In Hell, Quanxi gets decapitated and Long and Pingtsi are killed. However when transported back, Tsugihagi manages to obtain Quanxi's head and when looking back she realises that Long and Pingtsi have been killed. She stands at the top of the building that had been sent to hell and pulls out an arrow from under Quanxi's eyepatch. She then drops Quanxi's head to the fight that was occurring between Denji and Santa Claus below, allowing Quanxi to transform into her hybrid form and kill the dolls that were attacking Denji.

After Santa Claus has been dealt with. Makima appears out from the smoke, drawing her sword. Quanxi surrenders, pleading to Makima to not kill her women, even offering her own limbs so that she won't. However, her words are futile, and Makima kills Quanxi, Cosmo and Tsugihagi by decapitating them.
